name: lab706Aggregate
description: Aggregate dataset for the MOH 706 report. Runs over lab706Base v2.2, whose test slots carry raw values (result_concept_id for coded tests, result_numeric for numeric tests), so the = 703 positivity rules and the numeric banding rules compare real data. Every test carries a total_/positive_ pair plus banding where authored. Aggregates without a GROUP BY on purpose: the report screen reads one summary row for the whole period and location selection. v2.2: panel indicators come from the base's member-aware flags over etl.flat_moh_706_report_results - total_fbc/total_lipid_profile/total_urinalysis count orders with >= 1 member result, positive_urinalysis counts orders where any dipstick member coded POSITIVE (previously always 0: panel head obs are valueless), fbc_hb_* bands read the HGB (21) member via the base fbc_hgb slot (previously one arbitrary member value was banded as if it were Hb). The *_with_members sums add urinalysis-member occurrences to the standalone analyte counts - aliases are additive; the legacy aliases stay comparable with historical numbers until the counting semantics are signed off. v2.3: indicators for the reportable-concept expansion (numeric totals/min/max, coded totals/positives, specimen counts); hiv_new_diagnosis counts distinct patients first diagnosed (enrolled) within the reporting period at the reporting location; the base's has-result filter keeps every indicator to tests actually done. v2.3.1: with_members indicators for microscopy analytes and total_urine_microscopy (panel-member aware). v2.4: per-indicator low/high counts (SUMs of the base v2.4 reference-range flags over etl.reference_ranges; tumour markers high-only; NULL bounds count 0). v2.5: indicators for the additional reportable concepts - coagulation profile (member-aware base flag), CA 15-3 / CA 125 (max/min/total + high counts), 1.10 bacteria, 5.12-5.28 epidemic-prone organisms and 7.8 hepatitis A (total_/positive_ pairs), 5.2-5.8 bacteriology specimens and 6.4-6.25 histology/cytology specimen sites (total_ counts); runs over lab706Base v2.5. 5.15 V. cholerae O139 shares concept 53316 with 5.14 and has no indicator until its own concept exists - see moh-706-additional-concepts-plan.md in the etl repo. v2.6: lipid disaggregation indicators are member-aware (*_with_members totals over the base v2.7 value slots; the low/high bands stay on their existing aliases, now member-aware in the base).
